findings.current: **(Best Comment)** The situation really is as serious as the post says, but the author is laying it on a little thick lol. I heard 100,000 ordinary Hunters alone have joined the fighting. What’s there to worry about? Is the military just sitting around doing nothing?
findings.defect: The draft omits the participating S-rank Hunters, materially understating the forces deployed.
findings.rationale: S급 헌터들에 explicitly adds S-rank Hunters to the hundred thousand ordinary Hunters.
findings.replacement: **(Best Comment)** The situation really is as serious as the post says, but the author is laying it on a little thick lol. There are S-rank Hunters in the fight, plus a hundred thousand regular Hunters. What’s there to worry about? And is the military just sitting around?
findings.source: (Best댓글) 글 내용대로 심각한 상황은 맞는데, 글 작성자가 너무 분위기 쎄게 잡은 것도 있음ㅋㅋ S급 헌터들에 일반 헌터만 10만 명 참전했다는데 뭐가 그리 걱정임. 그리고 군대는 놀고 있냐?

findings.current: └ No. They’re just reacting that way because it’s all in English and they can’t understand a thing. They’re running it through Goggle Translate right now.
findings.defect: The draft changes the speaker’s first-person admission into a claim about other people, reversing the subject of both the misunderstanding and the translation action.
findings.rationale: 몰라서 and 돌리고 있음 describe the commenter’s own inability to understand the English and their own use of the translator.
findings.replacement: └ No. I only reacted like that because it’s all in English and I have no idea what it says. I’m running it through Goggle Translate right now.
findings.source: └ 아니. 그냥 죄다 영어라 뭔 소린지 몰라서 그런 건데. 지금 가글 번역기 돌리고 있음.

findings.current: **(Best Comment)** Security Council official: The front in the east-west sector broke through an hour ago. Fortunately, Pai Chen arrived as reinforcements and prevented the damage from spreading.
findings.defect: “The front … broke through” makes the front the advancing actor, whereas 뚫림 means that the front was breached. “Arrived as reinforcements” also makes the singular Pai Chen grammatically plural.
findings.rationale: The following comments ask why the front was breached despite Wu Heixing’s presence; they do not describe that front successfully advancing.
findings.replacement: **(Best Comment)** Security Council official: The front in the east-west sector was breached an hour ago. Fortunately, Pai Chen arrived as reinforcement and prevented the damage from spreading.
findings.source: (Best댓글) 안보리 오피셜, 한 시간 전 동서부 쪽 전선 뚫림. 다행히 파이 첸이 지원군으로 와서 피해 확산은 막았다고 함.

findings.current: └ Do you work for the Quality Control Committee for the comments above? That was fucking clear.
findings.defect: The draft misattaches “the comment above” to the committee, producing a nonsensical committee that performs quality control on comments.
findings.rationale: The line continues the “Chinese-made” versus “Hong Kong-made” product-quality joke by comparing the previous commenter to a quality-control worker.
findings.replacement: └ Does the commenter above work in quality control or something? That was fucking clear.
findings.source: └ 윗 댓글 품질 관리 위원회에서 일하냐? ㅈㄴ 명쾌하네.

findings.current: └ Shut your mouth and pull down the shutters. Today is the innkeeper’s death anniversary…
findings.defect: The literal rendering neither identifies 주모 as the tavern woman invoked in Korean patriotic internet jokes nor gives an English reader enough context to understand the punchline.
findings.rationale: The line caps the national-pride reversal by invoking the recurring 주모 drinking meme, then exaggerating the celebration into her death anniversary.
findings.replacement:
└ Shut up and pull down the shutters. Today is the tavern lady’s death anniversary…[^1]

[^1]: Korean internet slang calls for a tavern lady to pour celebratory drinks when national pride surges; the joke is that today’s celebration will work her to death.
findings.source: └ 입 다물고 셔터 내려라. 오늘 주모 제삿날이다…….

findings.current: Covered in blood and dust, he looked at me with calm, deeply sunken eyes.
findings.defect: “Deeply sunken eyes” describes Choi’s physical eye sockets, while 깊게 가라앉은 describes the grave, subdued quality of his gaze.
findings.rationale: 침착하면서도 깊게 가라앉은 characterizes his composed but heavy expression after four days of battle, not anatomical gauntness.
findings.replacement: Covered in blood and dust, he looked at me with a calm, somber gaze.
findings.source: 핏물과 먼지로 뒤덮인 그는 침착하면서도 깊게 가라앉은 눈동자로 날 바라보았다.

summary: Several subject and action reversals obscure who breached each front, alongside one omitted force quantity and localized losses of humor and characterization.
